title: Building a Magicka-inspired extraction looter with Opus 5.5!
author: Toonenator
selftext:
I really love the mechanics in Magicka, despite it being a 15 year old game. I thought it'd be cool to take that mechanic and build an extraction looter around it, which is another one of my favorite genres!

The idea is that you choose to go into the wild in a group or alone to collect loot while fighting off mobs or other players. I built a prototype of the combat experience and it feels really challenging to learn because of all the different combos available. Would love for PVP to feel fast-paced and hectic!
